metadata.label: Monochrome
metadata.coverage: Galileo clear-filter observations registered to the PDS shape. Bounded illumination normalization and overlap brightness matching reduce photographed shading. This is relative image brightness, not calibrated albedo. Gray grid marks unobserved or unreliable samples; cast shadows are not reconstructed.

celestial.sunSource: JPL Jupiter-system ephemeris and IAU/WGCCRE rotation; the Stooke source origin and west-positive longitude are preserved.

panel.introduction: Thebe is a small, irregular moon inside Io’s orbit. Its battered surface includes the enormous crater Zethus, and dust from impacts feeds Jupiter’s faint outer gossamer ring.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Galileo clear-filter observations registered to the PDS shape. Bounded illumination normalization and overlap brightness matching reduce photographed shading. controls.title: SSI mosaic
controls.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading without measuring albedo. The gray grid marks missing or unreliable images.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 49.3 km reference sphere from Stooke’s Galileo-derived shape model. Shows the broad irregular shape, not local altitude above a geoid. The archived 5° grid includes modeled unseen terrain and may exaggerate depressions; it is not a high-resolution terrain survey.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Galileo-model height relative to a 49.3 km sphere. Unseen terrain is modeled; depressions may be exaggerated.
